title: GFP barrel and chromophore
prompt: Load green fluorescent protein (1EMA) as a cartoon, colour the chromophore orange, and also show it as orange ball-and-stick.

provenance.derived: The chromophore is the modified residue CRO (author residue 66), part of the polymer chain, so it has a cartoon trace as well as the added ball-and-stick; the prompt names the colour of both. The July colour (green, hand-picked RGB) is replaced by a Mol* colour name.

notes: Domain fact: the GFP chromophore is the non-standard residue CRO.
